part.text:
All 27 tests pass (5 suites). Summary of the changes:

- **`src/templates.ts`** (new) — `TemplateEngine` class: compiles Handlebars layouts from `templates/layouts/`, registers partials from `templates/partials/`, requires a `default.hbs` layout, throws clear errors for a missing templates dir, missing default layout, or an unknown requested layout.
- **`templates/`** (new) — `layouts/default.hbs`, `layouts/post.hbs` (example alternate layout), `layouts/index.hbs`, and `partials/{nav,header,footer}.hbs`. Layouts use `{{{body}}}` for unescaped page content.
- **`src/types.ts`** — `Page` gained an optional `layout` field, populated from frontmatter.
- **`src/generator.ts`** — `build()` now takes an optional `templatesDir` (defaults to `./templates` relative to cwd), constructs a `TemplateEngine`, and renders each page/index through it instead of the old hardcoded HTML strings.
- **`src/render.ts`** — trimmed to `renderMarkdown` and `renderIndexBodyHtml` (the old full-document `renderPageHtml`/`renderIndexHtml` are superseded by the template engine).
- **`src/cli.ts`** — added `--templates <dir>` option (default `./templates`).
- **`package.json`** — added `handlebars` dependency (already vendored in `node_modules`).
- Tests updated/added: `tests/templates.test.ts` (isolated engine unit tests — partials, escaping, layout selection, error cases), `tests/generator.test.ts` (custom-layout frontmatter, missing-layout error, cwd-default templates dir), `tests/cli.test.ts` (`--templates` wiring), `tests/render.test.ts` (trimmed to match the new module).

Verified with a real CLI build (default layout, `layout: post` override, partials, tags, dates all render correctly) and `tsc` compiles clean.
